metadata.name: GetLinkCardsDetails
metadata.description: Use this API to get details of all the linked cards with User ID linked with given Card or Proxy Number.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: ProxyNumber
request_fields.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 NOTE: Please provide Proxy Number used for user registration. Condition : At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001 NOTE: Please provide CardNumber used for user registration. Condition : At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: IsCardMasked
request_fields.description: Flag to indicate Card Number should be returned in masked form or in clear form. Valid Values: 0 = Clear Card Number in Response. 1 = Masked Card Number in Response. 2 = No Card Number in Response. Note : Default value is 1 Example : Blank,0,1,2 Allowable Values: 1

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account Number of the cardholder. Valid values: 0-9 Example: 2000000000000396893

children.name: FirstName
children.description: Cardholder First Name Valid Values: A-Z, a-z Example: Andrew

children.name: CurrentBalance
children.description: Current Balance of Account Example: 5425.00

children.name: ManualCardStatus
children.description: Manual Card Status code Refer Appendix section : Card Status Values Example : 0

children.name: ManualCardStatusName
children.description: Manual Card Status Name. Example: Active,Closed

children.name: SubProductType
children.description: Sub Product type code Valid Value: 0-9 Example: 29 = Access Cards, 6 = Gift Cards, 10=Payroll Cards

children.name: SubProductTypeDescription
children.description: Sub Product Description Example: Access Cards, Gift Cards

children.name: ReloadsAllowed
children.description: Whether reloads are allowed or not. Valid Values : 0 = No / 1 = Yes

children.name: ProxyNumber
children.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005

children.name: ProductID
children.description: ID of the Account's Product Valid Values:0-9 Example: 1739,1758

children.name: ProductDescription
children.description: Product Description

children.name: LinkCardStatus
children.description: Status of the link card Valid Values : 1 = Primary Card, 2 = Linked Card

children.name: LoginFlag
children.description: This tag indicates the login flag. Valid Values: 0 = Do not Allow 1 = Allow Example: 1

children.name: CardType
children.description: Type of the card Valid values : 0 = Primary Card 1 = Secondary Card Example : 1

children.name: CardNumber
children.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Example: 123456******0001 Valid Values: When IsCardMasked = 0.Card Number without Masked in Response. When IsCardMasked = 1. Card Number with Masked in Response. When IsCardMasked = 2. No Card Number in Response.

children.name: LinkCardAccess
children.description: whether access for the card that Is linked is available or not. Valid Values - Yes , No

children.name: DelinkCardAccess
children.description: whether access to Delinked card is available or not Valid Values : Yes , No

children.name: IsExceededActivateEnrollCounter
children.description: Whether card exceeded the allowed limit or not Valid values: True or False

children.name: SACAsk
children.description: Security Access Code(SAC)  required or not during delinking of card Valid values : YES and NO

children.name: LongFormDisclosureENPDF
children.description: Long form disclosure agreement in English language in PDF format.

children.name: LongFormDisclosureESPDF
children.description: Long form disclosure agreement in Spanish language in PDF format.

children.name: LongFormDisclosureENJPG
children.description: Long form disclosure agreement in English language in JPG format.

children.name: LongFormDisclosureESJPG
children.description: Long form disclosure agreement in Spanish language in JPG format.
